system.effect: Double the amount of actions a character can perform per round for 10 minutes
system.legality: Roll OVER the local Law Level for the drug to be legal (p.120).
system.description:
Users experience time at a slower rate by accelerating their metabolism, allowing them to act twice as much in a combat round. The drug takes 1 minute to take effect and lasts for 10 minutes. The spacer takes 1D damage after the drug wears off and is “pinned” for a number of 10 minute intervals equal to the damage taken.

Effect: Double the amount of actions a character can perform per round for 10 minutes. Price: 500cr. TL: 8. Available: 9+.

Availability: Roll under the Available chance, with a DM equal to the difference between the drug's Tech Level and the planet's Tech Level.

Dosage: Prices are given for 1 dosage. Synergy: Multiple drugs can be taken for multiple effects to take place simultaneously; any drawbacks are also incorporated, but multiply the drawback by D3.

Addiction: a character can prevent becoming dependent if they only consume it once every week for Slow, Combat, PSI, and Recreational drugs or once every three months for Fast drugs. Consuming within the abuse window requires an END roll equal to or more than the drug’s Available roll to avoid dependency. Effect of addiction: -D3 END every week the drug is not consumed; at END 0, damage to STR and DEX equally; consuming the drug in this period recovers 3 wounds. Treatment: one-month medical stay at a treatment center on a TL12 planet, 50,000Cr.

system.legality: Roll OVER the local Law Level for the drug to be legal (p.120).
